purpose: Test whether the twelve zero-base feature hypotheses and five candidate-universe hypotheses remain useful after replacing the failed sign-logit anchor with the independently identified daily-rank Ridge anchor.

anchor.target: within each training day, average percentile rank of observed open-to-close return mapped to [-1,1]
anchor.sample_weight: each training date sums to one
anchor.training: expanding from 2024-01-04, retrained each calendar month, minimum 60 training sessions

ranking.sort: model score descending then code ascending
ranking.unfilled: cash if the pre-ranking candidate set contains fewer than two rows; candidate-universe recipes rank within their frozen mask and never perform a post-ranking replacement

feature_screen.comparison: G0 plus exactly one registered group versus G0
discovery_qualification_all_required: positive monthly uplift fraction at least 0.5
shared twelve-candidate max-t five-session block-bootstrap one-sided 80 percent lower bound nonnegative
feature_screen.reporting: all twelve groups in discovery, both confirmations and overall regardless of discovery sign

universe_screen.comparison: common fitted G0 rank-Ridge scores, then restrict only the scoring candidate set by exactly one registered point-in-time mask
universe_screen.training_policy: do not change training rows; this isolates candidate-set value and permits maturity filters whose eligible history starts after the initial training window
universe_screen.reporting: all five masks in discovery, both confirmations and overall regardless of discovery sign

shadow_survivor_all_required: at least 9 of 13 monthly net20 means positive
at least 3 of 4 fixed blocks positive
positive uplift versus rank-Ridge G0 in discovery, confirmation A and confirmation B
promotion: forbidden; a retrospective survivor is only a prospective shadow candidate
